main.description:
Generic per-row transform — applies a declarative mapping to each input row. Bridges fetched arrays (e.g. http.fetch + json.extract output) and downstream sql.exec INSERT rows that need restructured fields. Mapping grammar (Python-free, defensive subset):

  - `"$.path[0].key"` → copy from input row at the given dotted path (same grammar as json.extract)
  - `{"const": <any>}` → literal constant value
  - `{"fmt": "prefix-{a.b}-suffix"}` → format string with {paths} substituted from input row
  - `{"path": "$.x", "default": <any>}` → path with fallback when missing

`defaults` is a dict of constant fields applied to every output row (overridden by `mapping`).

input.description: Source rows. Each item must be an object.

mapping.description: Dict of {outputKey: spec} where spec is either a string (= path) or one of the structured forms above.

defaults.description: Constant fields applied to every output row (overridden by mapping).

rows.description: Transformed rows. Same length as input (or fewer if any row failed validation — `skipped` count tracks that).
